title: 262 Garfield Street Vacation Rental
meta_description: 262 Garfield Street is a 5.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:-Parking for 3 Vehicles (Jeep is not available for guest use.)-Propane Gas Grill-Exterior Shower-Outside Balcony with Gulf Views-Steps away from the beloved Red Bar-Steps to the Beach DETAILS:Grayton Beach has been named one of the top 10 most beautiful beaches in the world by Travel and Leisure and Conde Nast. Your slice of heaven awaits you at the spacious beach house called Sea Forever in the heart of Grayton Beach! This brightly decorated beach house features five bedrooms and four and a half bathrooms, comfortably sleeping up to 14 guests. Three bedrooms come with king-size beds and private bathrooms, while two fun children's rooms share a “Jack and Jill” bathroom, equipped with bunk beds, a full bed, and a twin bed. The large, well-stocked kitchen and spacious dining area invite family meals, while the cozy living room offers a TV, DVD player, and plenty of board games for entertainment.Enjoy the two large front porches, where the Gulf breeze and views provide an ideal setting for playing cards or al fresco dining. You can also grab a hammock chair and lose yourself in that book you’ve been wanting to read. With hardwood flooring, eclectic local art, and vibrant colors throughout, Sea Forever captures the essence of coastal living. And with the beach just 37 steps from your front door, paradise is always within reach! SECOND FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: Two Twin Over Twin Bunk Beds (4), Shared Bathroom with Walk In Shower-Guest Bedroom: One Twin Bed (1), One Full Bed (2), Shared Bathroom with Walk In Shower-Guest Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Shower/ Tub Combo-Guest Bedroom: King Bed (2), One Twin Day Bed (1), Private Bathroom with Shower/ Tub Combo THIRD FLOOR:-Master Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Walk In Shower and Soaking Tub-Half Bathroom -Laundry Area-Kitchen-Main Living Area
